description: List an allowlisted read-only Meta Graph edge with caller-selected flat fields, filters, and cursor pagination. Use this for broad metadata/entity discovery when a specialized tool does not expose a newly added field.

after.description: Opaque cursor for the next page returned by Meta.

before.description: Opaque cursor for the previous page returned by Meta.

edge.description: Allowlisted Meta Graph edge to read on the selected node.

fields.description: Native provider fields to return. Select only fields supported by the chosen object or report.

filtering.description: Native provider filter expressions; credentials and account overrides are not allowed.

includeSummary.description: Request the provider's available summary or total-count metadata.

limit.description: Maximum number of returned items or rows. The declared bounds and default apply; use pagination for additional results.

parameters.description: Additional documented GET parameters, for example targeting_spec or optimization_goal; auth and HTTP method override parameters are blocked

parentId.description: Parent Graph node ID, such as act_123, a Business, Page, catalog, campaign, or ad set ID

since.description: Beginning of the requested reporting period; use the format accepted by the provider.

until.description: End of the requested reporting period; use the format accepted by the provider.

name: meta_list_edge_raw

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text or multiple MCP content blocks. Provider fields depend on the selected query.

title: meta list edge raw
